title: Service Missed-Streak Recovery Time
dataSources: Prayer sessions (`faith:rosary`), retreat events (`faith:retreat`), attendance logs (`faith:attendance`), fasting journals (`faith:fast`), practice reviews (`faith:ops`).
app: Spiritual-practice telemetry — rosary counters, meditation-retreat schedules, church-attendance logs, and fasting journals — streamed to Splunk HEC via exports and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=faith:attendance service_type=* miss_epoch=* return_epoch=*
| eval lag_days=round((return_epoch-miss_epoch)/86400,1)
| stats avg(lag_days) as avg_lag_days, max(lag_days) as worst_lag_days by service_type
| sort - avg_lag_days
description: Measures missed-streak recovery time by service type for attendance recovery.
value: Lag tracking shows which service type create the slowest handoffs, syncs, or review loops inside attendance recovery.
implementation: Capture the timestamps needed to compute `missed-streak recovery time` on `faith:attendance` events and aggregate them by `service_type`.
visualization: Table of service type with average and worst missed-streak recovery time.
grandmaExplanation: It lists how long things take for each service type so you can see where attendance recovery slows down.
